Ukraine Air Raid Alert System Hacked, Sent False Alarms

Ukraine's air raid alert system experienced "hostile interference" when its public alert application was hacked, causing it to send erroneous alerts, the Ukrainian air force announced. The interference affected the system's ability to function as intended.
